name: NonConformanceReport
tagline: Raise, contain, disposition and close NCRs – with MRB sign-off, cost of poor quality and CAPA rules – in one Power Apps control.
description: A manufacturing non-conformance report for Model-driven apps, Canvas apps and Power Pages: defect codes from a searchable catalogue, containment hold and suspect-stock checks, Material Review Board disposition (use as is, rework, repair, return to vendor, scrap) with sign-off, cost of poor quality, CAPA triggers from severity, quantity, repeat defects and cost, workflow gates and an activity log. Stored as JSON in one column.
features: Searchable defect-code catalogue with severity and Pareto
Containment hold, quarantine quantity and suspect-stock checks
MRB disposition split with balance bar, instructions and concessions
Cost of poor quality: scrap, labour and RTV handling
CAPA rules: severity, quantity, repeat defect, COPQ, customer escape
Workflow gates with linked error summary
Phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader support
24 outputs and a change event for Power Pages
